name: editorial
description: 2D · flat warm colour, serif headline with italic emphasis words, and a phone that runs across two slides.
design_notes: Magazine-like look. One flat warm colour fills every slide. Headlines are serif, centred, with the emphasis words in italic (not in another colour). Some slides pair up: the phone is cut by the slide edge and continues on the next slide. Needs a system serif font such as Georgia; falls back to the bundled sans.
